author_rights: Reproduction, communication to the public and making available, distribution (arts 2-4)
moral_rights: Outside the Directive's scope; left to Member States and Berne Convention (recital 19)
orphan_works: Permitted use by cultural institutions after a diligent search (Directive 2012/28/EU)
digital_protection: Legal protection of technological measures (art. 6 Directive 2001/29/EC)
notes: Describes the harmonised EU framework. The EU itself is not a party to the Berne Convention (all its Member States are); it is a party to TRIPS, the WCT and the WPPT
pending_change: New Commission copyright proposal expected in 2027 (call for evidence May 2026)
